title: CmdPal: Keep Adaptive Card input values when the theme changes

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The accumulated assessment established no proven current defect in preserving Adaptive Card inputs across theme changes. The exact declared renderer getter forwards TextBox.Text directly rather than automatically formatting or normalizing numbers. That static contract does not prove which locale-specific numeric strings the renderer accepts as valid, so a speculative parsing fallback is not requested.

**Validation scope:** The exact renderer package producer was statically checked. Interactive de-DE/fr-FR numeric validation/submission and before/after-theme behavior have not been established; those are open validation questions rather than confirmed data-loss findings.

No additional code change is requested by this assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.
